source_text: Meretrix sapiens exploratoribus consilium dat: Per montana abite — humilia refugite, excelsa praedicate. Signum coccineum in domo ponit — sanguinis formam; salus nisi in sanguine Christi. Omnes in domo tua salvabuntur; qui exierint, immunes sumus. Si quis salvari vult, veniat in hanc domum — ecclesiam — ubi Christi sanguis in signo redemptionis est. Apud eos qui dixerunt Sanguis eius super nos, sanguis in condemnationem. Extra hanc domum nemo salvatur. Signum in fenestra — incarnationis lumen non merum Deitatis aspectum sed per fenestram. Mundati in aqua et Spiritu et in sanguine Iesu Christi, cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Harlot wise to-spies counsel gives: Through mountains depart — low-things flee, high-things preach. Sign scarlet in house she-places — of-blood form; salvation unless in blood of-Christ. All in house your will-be-saved; who shall-have-gone-out, immune we-are. If anyone to-be-saved wishes, let-him-come into this house — church — where of-Christ blood in sign of-redemption is. With those who said Blood his upon us, blood unto condemnation. Outside this house no-one is-saved. Sign in window — of-incarnation light not pure of-Deity sight but through window. Cleansed in water and Spirit and in blood of-Jesus Christ, to-whom glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: The wise harlot gives the spies a heavenly counsel: [[Go by the mountain way >> Bible:Joshua 2:16]] — flee the low valleys; preach what is high. She sets a [[scarlet cord in her house >> Bible:Joshua 2:18]] — the form of blood; there is no salvation except in Christ’s blood. [[All found in your house will be saved; we are clear of those who go out >> Bible:Joshua 2:19]]. Whoever would be saved, come into this house — the church — where Christ’s blood is the sign of redemption. With those who said [[His blood be on us and on our children >> Bible:Matthew 27:25]], that blood is unto condemnation. [[Jesus was set for the fall and rising of many >> Bible:Luke 2:34]]. Outside this house — outside the church — no one is saved. The sign hangs in the window: the incarnation lets us see deity’s light not bare, but as through a window. Cleansed in water and Spirit and in the blood of Jesus Christ our Lord, [[to whom be glory forever. Amen >> Bible:Galatians 1:5]].
